overview_description.description: AiPrise provides a compliance platform and API integration for verifying businesses and individuals across many countries to mitigate risk and prevent fraud. The platform includes solutions for Know Your Business (KYB), Know Your Customer (KYC), and ongoing fraud monitoring with customizable rule engines. AiPrise also offers a Compliance Co-pilot, an AI-assisted tool for case review, document analysis, and Enhanced Due Diligence report generation.

about_short_description.short_description: AiPrise provides a compliance platform to verify businesses and individuals globally.

product.name: Business Verification
product.description: Verifies the legitimacy and details of businesses globally using registry data, ownership verification, and social signals to support compliance and risk management.

product.name: User Verification
product.description: Verifies individual identities worldwide using document checks, biometric selfies, and local ID documents to ensure compliance and reduce fraud.

product.name: Fraud & Risk Scoring
product.description: Assesses fraud risk by analyzing email, phone, device data, and social signals with customizable rules to detect and prevent fraudulent activity.

product.name: Compliance Co-pilot
product.description: An AI-powered compliance assistant that automates document review, sanctions screening, and enhanced due diligence report generation to speed up compliance workflows.

product.name: Document Insights
product.description: Automates extraction and verification of data from user and business documents to detect tampering and ensure consistency with claimed information.

product.name: Government Verifications
product.description: Verifies identities by cross-checking user or business data against official government and private databases worldwide to ensure accuracy and compliance.
